description.en:
Joseph lived an ordinary life and it all took a turn when he realized he was being stalked. First, his school, then his locker, his phone and eventually his home- every aspect of his life was infiltrated by his stalker. Joseph is at his wits' end when Glen, a stranger, steps into his life at just the right moment and offers him a helping hand.

Joseph sıradan bir hayat yaşıyordu ve takip edildiğini fark edene kadar her şey yolundaydı. Önce okulu, sonra dolabı, telefonu ve nihayetinde evine, hayatının her kısmına takipçisi sızmıştı. Joseph'e bir yabancı olan GLEN, doğru zamanda hayatına adım atıyor ve ona yardım eli uzatıyor

description.pt-br: Joseph vive uma vida comum e simples, mas com o tempo ele percebe que está sendo perseguido por alguém. Coisas estranhas começam a acontecer, e Joseph começa a se sentir ameaçado, encurralado e muito apavorado. Glen aparece na vida de Joseph no momento certo oferecendo uma mão amiga. O que acontecerá com ambos? Quem é este perseguidor? Porque Glen um estranho estende a mão em um momento como este?

description.en: Humans are no longer at the top of the food chain. The creatures known as “Insectors” hide amongst us, using their supernatural insectile powers to prey upon humans. Miseong, a seemingly ordinary high school student, is also secretly an Insector. But unlike others of his kin, he directs his powers not at humans, but at Insectors instead. Will he maintain control over his abilities and use them for the good of mankind, or will he succumb to the monster within him?

description.en:
"I like you!"
Beyond the world we live in lies a place called the Garden, inhabited by otherworldly divine beings known as Plantus. 
An ordinary human named Lee Lumi happens to encounter Aleph, an incomplete Plantus who has arrived in this world. 
Having read "The Little Prince," Aleph claims she came in search of "a one-of-a-kind friend." Reluctantly, Lumi agrees to be her friend. 
But soon after, a figure who looks exactly like Aleph appears, calling Lumi a "gardener" and acting as though they've known each other for a long time. 
Meanwhile, a suspicious professor seems to know far too much about Aleph and the Plantus. 
As Lumi digs deeper, she begins to notice eerie similarities between the Plantus and the stories on SPR Institute, a paranormal website supposedly dedicated to protecting humanity.

We find Chunwha in a world beyond his own… There he will struggle to find his own purpose among the many inhabitants of the new world including elves, dwarves, and even mages! As we watch him grow in strength and spirit, the manhwaga creates fascinating characters out of his companions and adversaries and moves past the simple concept of the antagonist vs the protagonist.   
  
To find out what fate has in store for our hero, follow Id in a fantastic adventure, exploring a world where anything is possible!

Minu Seo, a struggling nobody, never thought he'd inherit anything, especially not from the mother who abandoned him. However, what he received was beyond anything he could have imagined... A kindergarten for divine beasts! Will Minu be able to look after these magical children as their new teacher?

description.en:
Lydia Planang is called a monster because of her scales. She was treated like a minor and forced to marry by the order of the emperor. Her fiancé is a wild and fierce sailor. He is the admiral of Chillia, who is rumored to be very sadistic. But when he first met her, he was incredibly nice to her…?

"My husband just grabbed his wife's hand and he was already screaming."

Lydia learns little by little about Chillia's secret in the admiral's intense love. Dragons, giant octopuses, sea snakes, fairies and mermaids… A destined love after marriage on the splendid ocean!

**

"I know a plant that can help my husband increase his stamina."

Alexander leaned over and whispered in her ear, "If you weren't satisfied last night, I'll try to find it."

"…Oh no!" Last night! Lydia literally blushed as she recalled her secrets that she couldn’t tell anyone.

---
They call her a monster... but to this admiral, she's a sacred descendant of the sea! Rudia Flang has been mistreated her whole life, so when the emperor arranges her marriage to Alexander Cilia, war hero and the youngest admiral in history, she cowers in fear at the thought of marrying a violent seaman. As this ocean voyage treks on, she's met with benevolence from the Sercilian Island people who, unbeknownst to her, find the scales glistening on her body far from the marking of a monster...

---

description.fr:
Lydia Plang a été appelée un monstre à cause de ses écailles. Elle a été traitée comme une sous-humaine et a été forcée de se marier par ordre de l'empereur. Son fiancé est un marin tropical sauvage et féroce. C'est un amiral de Chilia, dont on dit qu'il est atroce.

Mais il la rencontre pour la première fois et se montre étonnamment gentil avec elle...?

"Le mari a juste tenu la main de sa femme et cela l'a fait crier."

Lydia apprend peu à peu le secret de Chilia dans l'amour intense de l'amiral.

Dragons, krakens, serpents de mer, nymphes et sirènes, amour fatidique après le pré-mariage dans la belle mer! Un fantasme de romance marine unique qui n'a jamais été vu auparavant par un artiste calligraphe.

**

"Je connais une plante qui aide à l'endurance de mon mari."

Puis Alexandre se pencha et lui chuchota à l'oreille.

"Si vous n'avez pas aimé hier soir, je vais le trouver et l'essayer."
"…Oh non!"

La nuit dernière! Des choses trop secrètes pour être racontées à qui que ce soit venaient à l'esprit, et Lydia rougit.

description.ru: Лидию Плананг называли чудовищем из-за ее чешуи. С ней обращались как с недочеловеком, и по приказу императора она была вынуждена выйти замуж. Ее жених - дикий и свирепый тропический моряк. Он адмирал Килии и по слухам просто ужасен. Однако, при первой же встрече он неожиданно оказывается к ней добр…?
description.tr: Lydia Planang, pulları nedeniyle canavar olarak adlandırıldı. Alt insan muamelesi gördü ve imparatorun emriyle evlenmeye zorlandı. Nişanlısı vahşi ve vahşi bir tropikal denizcidir. Acımasız olduğu söylenen Chilia'nın bir amirali. Ancak, onunla ilk kez karşılaştığında ve beklenmedik bir şekilde ona karşı nazik davrandığında? description.en:
Ian Percus, a third-year student from the Academy's swordship department, wakes up one morning to find a flip calendar on his desk and a letter he doesn't remember receiving. The letter contains a cryptic message: "If we don't protect the future, the world will perish."

When he goes to the Academy, he finds out that, unbeknownst to him, a week has passed and that during that time, he defeated a previously undefeated junior. At first, Ian is skeptical, but as the events described in the letter begin to unfold, he gradually starts to believe what is written. What on earth happened during the week he has no memory of...? Will Ian be able to protect the future?

description.en: Heaven-bound Heavenly Demon, once known as Kang Taehan, Returns to his original life after 60 years! "Ah, in such a blessed era, to be in this shape!" "Your body is screaming to be saved, haven't you heard?" The project to physically and mentally rejuvenate everyone, The journey of the Heavenly Demon Kang Taehan begins!! Weary office workers tired from alcohol and overtime, Athletes whose bodies are ruined and performance declined, Heads of families crushed by the weight of life, Modern people who have accumulated fat to withstand life’s burdens. All you modern people who are weary of their life, come and get a massage!

Betrayed by his guild and defeated by a top player, Hyrkan loses everything. Before he can get revenge, a fatal accident ends his life — only for him to wake up years in the past, back at the start of Warlord. 

Now, with his memories intact, he’s determined to rise to the top alone. But in a game where power means everything, can he truly survive without any allies? 

The Emperor of Solo Play is back, and this time, he’s playing by his own rules.

2035년 가상현실게임 워로드의 등장은 세상을 바꾸었다.

그 세상에서 자신의 운명도 바꾸고 싶었던 안재현. 하지만 인생을 바꾸기 위해 일생을 게임에 바친 대가는 믿었던 동료들의 배신, 그 배신으로 모든 걸 잃은 안재현, 그런 그에게 온 재도전의 기회!

description.en:
"I'm a witch!" 

After ending the difficult life of Cheon Eun-ha due to an accident and bad luck, Bris was reborn as a witch in a fairy tale. Even from his friend Sion, he hides the fact that he is a witch and lives alone a little far from the village. Then one day, her fairy appears in front of her and she calls herself her dragon lord. 

"Yes? Fairy Ariel? Maybe the protagonist of that fantasy fairy tale? It's unfair that the place of reincarnation is in a fantasy fairy tale I read by chance, but I have to become a hero to defeat the demon king! How can a witch do that?" 

And Bris finds out the truth about another witch... Is the villain in this fairy tale really the villain?

---
After a life full of hardship and heartache, Chon-Eun Ha died in the hospital all alone. However, she woke up suddenly in a lush forest, reincarnated as a witch an a wonderous fantasy world full of magicians, knights and other creatures. A world so wonderous, in fact, that suddenly she finds a fairy has moved into her house. "My brave warrior! I've been waiting for you! I'm sorry I must have startled you!" What is this fairy doing in my house?! "My name is Ariel!" No way, ***the*** heavenly Ariel from the *Tale of Ariel*?!

---
Eun-Ha Cheon was just an ordinary teenage girl until she woke up one day and discovered that she was not Eun-Ha Cheon anymore, but a witch named Blythe in a magical world. Fearful of prejudice and desirous of a quiet life, she hides the fact that she’s a witch, but this becomes tricky with the arrival of a beautiful fairy who won’t stop calling her a warrior. She doesn’t want to be a warrior or anyone’s hero. All she wants is an ordinary life… But as she learns more about her identity and her world, will she ultimately get what she wants?

The Mystic Lunar Dance Troupe took in Jin Sohan as an orphan, and he spent his childhood with them. But one day, one of the four great demons, the Venom Demon, discovered that he was special and kidnapped him. After all kinds of tests, he decided to raise him as his disciple. Ten years later, Jin Sohan tried to look for traces of the Mystic Lunar Dance Troupe, but the Sword Dance Troupe had already been destroyed at the hands of the Unorthodox Faction that’s now ruling over his hometown.

---
Kidnapped as a child to be trained in the art of poison, Sohan Jin returns to his hometown in search of the group of New Moon Sword Dancers who raised him. However, upon his return, Sohan discovers the sword dancers have been defeated by a nefarious sect that now rules the area, with some members having been abducted. What would have been a heartwarming reunion transforms into a quest for revenge as Sohan begins his search for the remaining sword dancers, and he’s willing to poison anyone who gets in his way.

《狂魔重生》编剧新作！
恶人之徒出山惩治黑道！

description.en:
When I transmigrated into a novel, I did what anyone would do—propose to my favorite character, Grand Duke Reigrein. I mean, he’s the perfect man, so who wouldn’t want to marry him? As Schueur, I was supposed to be the villainess, but I’d rather save my honey! His Highness’s special ability consumes his emotions every time he uses it, so my goal is to awaken feelings in him. So far, I’ve only caused him irritation and annoyance, but one day I’ll make him notice me!

---
In this novel, my favorite character died. After being rejected by the female lead and losing his emotions, he could no longer use his abilities, and as he became weak, the North collapsed. Even his body was never to be found, but the novel only depicted the happy ending of the protagonists.

And I possessed the body of the villainess "Schuer" from that novel.

"Rather, I'll make him regain his emotions before he meets the female lead."

Thus, I left for the North.

"Grand Duke, can you hold my hand just once? Or maybe a signature. I'll keep it as a heirloom."

"If you want my signature, you too should sign and stamp here, my Lady."

"What's this?"

"A marriage certificate."

Huh?

"You can just act you usually do. It seems like your behavior is somewhat getting on my nerves."

...Did I win the jackpot?
description.fr:
Mon personnage préféré du roman est mort. Abandonné par l'Héroïne et ayant perdu ses émotions, il ne pouvait plus utiliser ses capacités, et lorsqu'il s'est affaibli, le Nord s'est effondré. Sans même retrouver son corps, le roman ne dépeint que la fin heureuse des personnages principaux. Et j'ai possédé la fille maléfique du roman, Shuire. Je préfère lui faire retrouver ses émotions avant qu'il ne rencontre l'héroïne. J'ai donc pris la direction du Nord.

«Duc, pouvez-vous me tenir la main? Ou peut-être un autographe. Je le garderai en héritage.»

«Si vous voulez avoir un autographe, Mademoiselle devrait aussi signer...»

«Qu'est-ce que c'est?»

«Un formulaire d'enregistrement de mariage.»

«Pardon?»

«Le comportement de Mademoiselle me rend nerveux.»

«...Ai-je une chance maintenant?»
description.id: Di novel ini, tokoh favoritku meninggal. Setelah ditolak oleh pemeran utama wanita dan kehilangan emosinya, dia tidak bisa lagi menggunakan kemampuannya, dan saat dia menjadi lemah, Korea Utara runtuh. Meski jenazahnya tidak pernah ditemukan, namun novel tersebut hanya menggambarkan akhir bahagia dari para protagonis. Dan aku memiliki tubuh penjahat “Schuer” dari novel itu. “Sebaliknya, aku akan membuatnya mendapatkan kembali emosinya sebelum dia bertemu dengan pemeran utama wanitanya.” Jadi, aku berangkat ke Utara. “Grand Duke, bisakah kamu memegang tanganku sekali saja? Atau mungkin tanda tangan. Saya akan menyimpannya sebagai pusaka.” “Jika Anda menginginkan tanda tangan saya, Anda juga harus menandatangani dan memberi stempel di sini, Nyonya.” "Apa ini?" “Surat nikah.” Hah? “Kamu bisa bertindak seperti biasanya. Sepertinya kelakuanmu membuatku jengkel.” …Apakah aku memenangkan jackpot?
description.ko:
소설 속 최애가 죽었다.
여주에게 버림받고 감정을 잃은 그는 더 이상 능력을 쓸 수 없었고,
그가 약해지자 북부는 무너졌다.
그의 시체조차 찾지 못한 채 소설은 주인공들의 해피엔딩만을 그렸다.

그리고 그 소설 속 악녀 ‘슈에르’에 빙의한 나.

‘차라리 그가 여주를 만나기 전에 감정을 되찾아 주겠어.’

그렇게 떠난 북부행.

“대공님, 저 손 한 번만 잡아 보면 안 될까요? 아니면 사인이라도. 가보로 간직할게요.”
“내 사인을 받고 싶다면 영애도 이곳에 사인과 지장을 찍게.”
“이게 뭔데요?”
“혼인 신고서.”

네?

“그저 지금처럼 하면 돼.
아무래도 영애의 행동이 내게 모종의 신경질을 유발하는 것 같거든.”

……저 설마 지금 계 탔나요?
description.pl: Umarł mój ulubiony bohater powieści. Po tym, jak został porzucony przez bohaterkę, stracił swoje emocje i nie mógł już używać swoich umiejętności. Gdy był osłabiony, Północ upadła. Powieść przedstawia szczęśliwe zakończenie dla głównych bohaterów, nie zadając sobie nawet trudu, by potwierdzić lokalizację jego ciała. Opętałam czarny charakter, Scheuera, i zdecydowałam, że wolę, aby odzyskał swoje emocje przed spotkaniem z bohaterką, więc udałam się na Północ. "Książę, potrzymasz mnie za rękę? A może dasz mi autograf? Obiecuję, że zachowam go na pamiątkę." "Jeśli chcesz mój autograf, to Pani również powinna się tu podpisać." "Co to jest?" "Formularz rejestracji małżeństwa." "Słucham?" "Tak jak teraz... zachowanie Pani sprawia, że czuję się zdenerwowany." ...Czy mam szansę?
description.ru:
Мой любимый персонаж в романе умер.

Покинутый главной героиней и потерявший свои эмоции, он больше не мог использовать свои способности, а когда ослабел, север пал.

Даже не найдя его тела, роман изображает счастливый конец главных героев. И я попала в злодейку из романа, Шуэр.

— Я бы предпочла вернуть ему эмоции до того, как он встретится с главной героиней. Для этого я направилась на север.

— Эрцерцог, не могли бы вы подержать меня за руку? Или, может быть, сделать автограф. Я сохраню его как семейную реликвию.

— Если вы хотите получить мой автограф, Леди также должна расписаться здесь.

— Что это?

— Форма регистрации брака.

— Бра... ка?

— Нет ничего, что вам было бы запрещено делать, чтобы вернуть мне эмоции.

description.en:
After passing out drunk on a cold night, I awake as a nameless young orphan girl. But she's not just any girl, she's a character from a novel I wrote in high school! Abused and sold at auction as a slave, I'm suddenly rescued by my father, Duke Henry Wensgrey, the story's original villain. Far from the wicked character I created, he's now a total fool for his daughter. But our relationship isn't the only thing that's changed, and I soon discover that this world isn't anything like what I wrote!

---
I possessed a character in a novel I had never finished writing when I was in high school. And then now I have the body of a supporting character instead of the main character. It was a seven-year-old orphan girl with no name… Having to suffer the abuse of others, until I got really tired and ran away from that place. But I was captured and sold as a slave. I thought my life was over… But the person who saved me was the novel's most prominent villain, Henriette.

He treats the emperor like a puppet. A person who has a reputation for being extremely cruel in the original and has a hobby of cutting the throat of aristocrats. …Is he my biological father? But other than that terrible reputation, living with him wasn’t bad either.

"Okay, my daughter. You can do whatever you want. If you want something, everyone in the family will do what you want."

Wait… I didn't write a novel like that in the first place?
description.fr: Toute ma vie j'ai trimé, étudié, courbé l'échine... alors mourir de froid, seule, abandonnée dans la rue, ça n'avait rien de surprenant. En revanche, me réincarner dans le corps d'un personnage du roman que j'ai écrit dans mon adolescence, ça ce n'était pas prévu! Surtout que ce personnage est la fille du grand méchant de l'histoire: c'est bien ma veine! Pas sûre d'avoir beaucoup plus de chance dans cette nouvelle vie... à moins que mon propre roman ne me réserve quelques surprises!
description.id:
"Hidupku jungkir balik dalam satu malam", sepertinya adalah satu kalimat yang cukup mendeskripsikan hidupku. Dalam satu malam, aku terlahir kembali menjadi karakter dalam novel yang kutulis dulu. Duke Wensgrey, ayah kandungku di kehidupan kali ini, tiba-tiba meninggal dan harus menitipkanku pada Count Semond. 7 tahun hidup penuh siksa, aku diculik dan dilelang! Apa yang selanjutnya akan terjadi padaku?

---
Ketika saya masih seorang siswa sekolah menengah, saya sangat terpesona oleh novel itu sehingga saya berhenti menulis. Dan sekarang saya merasuki tubuh karakter pendukung, bukan karakter utama. Itu adalah gadis yatim piatu berusia 7 tahun tanpa nama... Harus menderita melemahkan orang lain, sampai saya benar-benar lelah dan lari dari tempat itu. Tapi saya ditangkap dan dijual sebagai budak. Saya pikir hidup saya sudah berakhir ...Tetapi orang yang menyelamatkan saya adalah penjahat paling menonjol dalam novel, Henriette. Dia memperlakukan kaisar seperti boneka. Seseorang yang memiliki reputasi sangat kejam dalam aslinya dan memiliki hobi memotong tenggorokan bangsawan. …Apakah itu ayah biologisku? Tapi selain reputasi buruk itu, tinggal bersamanya juga tidak buruk. “Baiklah, sayangku” “Kamu bisa melakukan apapun yang kamu mau. Jika Anda menginginkan sesuatu, semua orang di keluarga akan melakukan apa yang Anda inginkan.” Tunggu… Aku tidak menulis novel seperti itu sejak awal?
description.ko:
고등학생 시절 취미로 쓰다 그친 소설 속에 빙의했다.
하필이면 주연도, 조연도 아닌
이름도 없는 일곱 살 고아 소녀에게 빙의했는데...

남의 집에서 구박데기로 살다 학대에 지쳐 달아났더니
붙잡혀 노예로 팔려 가 버렸다.

이번 생은 정말 망했구나 싶었는데...
노예 경매장에서 날 구해 낸 것은 바로
소설 속 등장하는 악명 높은 악역,
'헨리에트 시틀릿 웬즈그레이'였다.

그는 황제를 꼭두각시처럼 부리고,
귀족들의 목을 써는 게 취미인 원작 속 최대 최악의 악당이다.

... 그 사람이 나의 친부라고?

그런데, 악역이라는 명성과 다르게
실제로 함께 지내보니 뭔가 좀 이상한 것 같다.

"그래, 내 딸아."
"네가 하고 싶은 것은 다 해도 좋다. 우리 가문의 그 누구든,
너의 말이라면 반드시 귀 기울이고 그대로 행하며 이룰 테니."

잠깐...
내가 쓴 소설은 이렇지 않았던 것 같은데?
description.ru:
Попав в роман, написанный мною, когда еще училась в школе, — я стала семилетней сиротой, у которой не было даже имени. Я не являюсь ни главной героиней, ни хотя бы второстепенным персонажем.
Будучи в чужом доме, терпев все издевательства и унижения — я пыталась сбежать. Побег оказался безрезультатным, я была попросту поймана и продана в рабство.
Я хотела исчезнуть из этой жизни. Но... С аукциона рабов меня выкупил злодей романа с самой худшей репутацией – Генриетт Ситл Венгрей.
Он является истинным злодеем романа, чье хобби угрожать аристократам, управлять ими и императорской семьей, словно те марионетки.
И он мой настоящий отец?..
Но, оставшись с ним наедине, я поняла, что он далеко не такой, каким я его описывала в романе.

— «Хорошо, дочь моя. Ты вольна делать всё, чего только пожелаешь. Все в нашей семье сделают то, что ты скажешь».

Что пошло не так?..
description.tr: Lise öğrencisiyken romandan o kadar etkilenmiştim ki yazmayı bıraktım. Ve şimdi ana karakter yerine yardımcı karakterin vücuduna sahibim. 7 yaşında, isimsiz yetim bir kızdı… Gerçekten yorulup o yerden kaçana kadar başkalarının tacizine katlanmak zorunda kaldım. Ama yakalandım ve köle olarak satıldım. Hayatımın sona erdiğini sanıyordum… Ama beni kurtaran kişi, romanın en önde gelen kötü adamı Henriette idi. İmparatora bir kukla gibi davranıyor. Orijinalinde son derece acımasız olmakla ün yapmış ve aristokratların boğazını kesme hobisine sahip bir kişi. …Bu benim biyolojik babam mı? Ama bu korkunç ün dışında onunla yaşamak da fena değildi. "Tamam bebeğim" "İstediğini yapabilirsin. Bir şey istersen, ailedeki herkes senin istediğini yapar.” Bir dakika… Ben böyle bir roman yazmadım mı?
description.pt-br: Eu possuía um personagem em um romance que parei de escrever por hobby quando estava no ensino médio. Minha mãe morreu em um acidente, e dizem que meu pai morreu logo depois de ir para a cadeia. Graças a isso, fiquei órfã aos sete anos sem nome. Enquanto morava na casa de outra pessoa, estava exausto de trabalhar e fui pego fugindo. Em seguida, vendido para s * salvar comerciantes. Eu queria saber se esta vida foi feita para ser arruinada. O respeitável Duque, o maior vilão do Império, comprou-me. "Ela tem 7 anos, mas era pequena e muito magra." Henriette, a pior vilã do original, cujo hobby é fazer todo mundo agir como uma marionete, pregar peças na família imperial e ameaçar o pescoço da aristocracia, descobriu-se que aquele homem assustador é meu verdadeiro pai que foi preso! Mas você parece um pouco diferente do vilão original. "Bem, duque..." "Não." “…Oh, pai?” "Isso também." "...uh, papai?" “Sim, minha filha. O que você quer ter hoje? Henriette, que eu achava assustadora, é mais amigável do que eu pensava. “Se alguém te incomodar de agora em diante, você tem que contar pro seu irmão mais velho, ok? Vou afogá-los no fundo do lago.” “Devo ver flores com minha irmãzinha hoje? Há tantas sereias ornamentais na estufa de vidro. Achei que você iria gostar, então peguei eu mesmo. Fiz um bom trabalho? “Essa garota lenta! Papai te ligou... Não eu não sou doido! Droga, não seja idiota! Ahhh! Sim! Estou errado! OK?" Os novos irmãos eram definitivamente vilões no original, mas são muito mais legais do que eu pensava. "Tu podes fazer o que quiseres. Qualquer pessoa da família, se você disser, ouvirá com atenção e fará o que você disser”. Mas é estranho. O romance que escrevi não era originalmente assim. “…Se você me prometer algumas coisas, eu ficarei com você de novo. Eu não vou deixar você. “Você pode me ver a qualquer hora sem hora marcada.” "Eu devo? Eu sempre posso fugir para um lugar onde você nunca mais me encontrará. Ele franziu as sobrancelhas. Se eu soubesse que uma pequena palavra de expressão teria causado uma reação tão terrível, eu teria ficado de boca fechada. Foi quando eu estava no meio do arrependimento, "Você está enganado. Você acha que eu vou deixar você ir em primeiro lugar, isso não deveria ser possível primeiro? "…That?" "Quem disse que eu deixaria você fugir?" …Não importa o quanto eu pense sobre isso, acho que entendi errado. "Se você realmente fugir, você não deve ser pego por mim novamente."

description.ko:
천마신교의 권력 투쟁을 피해 초야에 은거한 주인공 명운. 
하지만 권좌에 뜻을 두지 않는 것만으로는 비극을 피할 수 없었다. 
명운은 골육상잔을 행하기 위해 찾아온 천마신교의 교주 명각을 피해 달아나던 중 추살당하고 만다. 
그 순간, 죽음을 앞두고 흐려지는 의식 속에서 누군가의 목소리가 들려온다.
‘…후회하는가? 다시 싸우길 원하는가?’
그 목소리를 끝으로 죽은 줄만 알았던 명운은 다시 눈을 뜨게 되는데….

description.en: Delinquency has become a major problem among the youth, especially the high school population. Taking the matter into their own hands, the government has created a special school just for these troubled youths. Kang Hae Hyo, a seemingly normal high school student who is bullied frequently, somehow ends up in the school! He's not sure he belongs there, but something him, and his past, may be discovered at this school…
description.pt: A delinquência tornou-se um grande problema entre os jovens, especialmente para alunos do ensino médio. Tomando o assunto em suas próprias mãos, o governo criou uma escola especial apenas para esses jovens problemáticos. Kang Hae Hyo, um estudante do segundo ano do colegial aparentemente normal que é maltratado com frequência, de alguma forma acaba na escola! Ele não tem certeza da razão pela qual está lá, mas algo sobre ele e seu passado podem ser descobertos nesta escola…

description.en:
What has a vampire who just woke up from a long sleep encountered… A zombie?!  
  
- [Original Webtoon (kakao)](https://page.kakao.com/home/53153957)

The maniac who was crazy about all kinds of fields such as military and steampunk had been reincarnated. However, his father was King Sejong the Great?
The mania-wise king and his crazy maniac son. Along with the ministers, and countless humans who were getting exploited.
Even today, the night of Joseon was filled with the light of overtime.

A miserable life where even dreams of love were out of reach. 
The night I tried to end my life from the exhaustion of my joyless marriage, a special invitation arrived unexpectedly.

[ You are an existence that gleams like the jewels.
The Jewel Box, where existences who shine like you gather... 
Would you like to enter the Jewel Box? YES? or NO? ]

[ The Empire's Jewel Box ] is a luxurious party attended by only the most outstanding people. A place where they can meet a marriage partner solely based on "true love" while concealing their face and status.
"If you were granted the opportunity to become a shining Jewel, like those who were specially selected..."

My choice from that night changed everything.

사랑 따윈 꿈꿔보지도 못한 초라한 삶.
불행한 결혼생활에 지쳐 목숨을 끊으려던 밤.
내게 특별한 초대장이 날아왔다.
 
[당신은 보석과 같이 빛나는 존재입니다.
당신처럼 빛나는 존재들이 모이는 보석함.
보석함에 들어오시겠습니까? YES? or NO?]
 

가장 특별한 사람들만이 참가할 수 있다는 화려한 파티. <제국의 보석함> 얼굴과 신분을 모두 숨긴 채, ‘진정한 사랑’에 의해 결혼 상대를 만나는 곳.
‘내게도 선택받은 자들처럼, 빛나는 보석이 될 기회가 주어진다면….’
 
그날 밤, 나의 선택이 모든 것을 뒤바꿔놓았다.

description.en:
I transmigrated into a fantasy novel where the constellations ruled the world. After 10 years, I finally managed to become the #1 S-rank Hunter and cleared the Tower... But not long after, I was yet again thrown into another novel, this time it was a romance fantasy, and to top it off I became the notorious villainess.

[<Diabolical Bloodlord> asks where in the hell this place is.] 
[<King of Healing Waves> is confused.] 
[<Lord of Temptation> is delighted with the familiar world.] 

Fortunately, the constellations followed me into the new world because apparently everyone's after my throat. Every day either someone tries to kill me or entangle me into one of their schemes…What did the princess do before I took possession of her body?

[<Diabolical Bloodlord>'s skill <Blessing of Poison> LV.999 purifies Mandrake's poison!] 
[<King of Healing Waves>'s skill <Blessing of Water> L V.999 perfectly heals wounds!] 
[<Lord of Temptation>'s skill <Temptation of Sleep> LV.999 puts the assassin to sleep!] 

This new lifestyle just isn't for me. It's too fresh/youthful/girlish compared to what I went through in my last life. But still I tried to clear the missions and enjoy my time here, until the male lead and my annoying brothers, who harassed me and didn't have an ounce of love for my "villainous" self, started to cling to me 

"It's good to be mischievous, but you can only do that in front of me. Got it?" 
"I regret that I didn't trust you back then." 
"...I don't deserve to beg for forgiveness, do I?" 

Even the mercenary king and the light of the empire won't leave me alone...
 "I have decided."
 "What?"
 "I will serve my lady as your teacher." (?)

Fine! I'm sorry, I did wrong! I'll accept any punishment you give me. I'll do whatever you want, anything, just please send me back to my world!

This is the story of how Lee Young escapes from the twists and turns as the #1 S-rank Hunter possesses the protagonist of a romance fantasy novel! Will she be able to go home after clearing this final mission?

description.en:
Ten years ago, a young girl saved the life of a dragon. Little did they know that they would be brought together again by the vicissitudes of fate, when Lucina’s family estate is invaded by the fearsome Tayar nation led by King Hakan. After Lucina’s selfish stepmother offers her up as a bride to Hakan in exchange for their lives, Lucina realizes that she is now fated to journey to the arid kingdom of Tayar and marry its seemingly brutish king. Will fate lead the unlikely pair to ruin or romance? 

---

**Note:** The novel originally serialized as R15, once its web serialization was completed, it released as R19 as an ebook (volumes). The webtoon will follow how it originally released, which is R15.
description.es: Diez años atrás, una niña le salvó la vida a un dragón. No imaginaban que las vueltas del destino los unirían nuevamente cuando la propiedad familiar de Lucina resulta invadida por la temible nación Tayar, liderada por el rey Hakan. Después de que la egoísta madrastra de Lucina la ofreciera en matrimonio a Hakan a cambio de sus vidas, Lucina se da cuenta de que está destinada a viajar al árido reino de Tayar y casarse con su rey que parece ser brutal. ¿Qué tendrá guardado el destino para esta extraña pareja? ¿Catástrofe o romance?
description.fr: Lucina, enfant illégitime du baron Berg, mène une vie misérable, entourée de sa famille et des servants qui la maltraitent. Elle parvient à gagner sa liberté à ses vingt ans par une étrange occasion, le roi des barbares, l'enlève pour qu'elle devienne sa femme.
description.id: Lucina, anak gelap dari Kerajaan Brion yang memiliki kekuatan penyembuhan bertemu dengan Hakkan, seekor naga dari Suku Tayar, yang sekarat. Siapa sangka, mereka bertemu lagi saat sang naga berniat untuk membantai masyarakat Brion. Tapi saat ingin melakukan pembantaian, Hakkan justru menikahi Lucina! Apa yang akan terjadi setelah pernikahan itu?
description.ko:
베르크 남작가의 사생아 루시나에게 일생일대의 기회가 찾아온다. 드래곤의 땅 타야르를 통치하는 대왕이자 정복자 하칸.
그의 약탈 신부가 되는 조건으로 주어진 또 다른 삶의 기회.
비록 반쪽짜리 자유라도 절실했던 루시나는 그렇게 미지의 세계로 발을 내딛게 되는데… 절망의 끝을 밝혀 준 단 하나의 사랑 이야기.
description.th: ชีวิตของลูซีน่า บุตรสาวนอกสมรสของบารอนเบล์ก ได้เปลี่ยนไปชั่วพริบตา ในวันที่เธอกำลังจะถูกขายให้เป็นนางสนมของราชาแก่ก็มีเหตุวุ่นวายบางอย่างเกิดขึ้น จับพลัดจับผลูให้เธอกลายเป็นเจ้าสาวของฮาคาน ผู้ปกครองที่ยิ่งใหญ่และน่าเกรงขามของเผ่ามังกรธายาร์ และเป็นคน (?) ที่เธอเคยช่วยชีวิตไว้เมื่อ 10 ปีก่อนอีกด้วย

贝尔格男爵家的私生女露西娜迎来了她一生绝无仅有的机会，那就是成为哈坎的掠夺新娘，一个统治龙之地—塔亚尔的大王兼征服者。迫切渴望自由的露西娜就这样踏上了未知的世界，开启了全新的生活………

Framed for a crime she didn’t commit, Isabel died leaving behind her little daughter. 10 years later, she awakens in another woman’s body, with only one year left to live.

But the world she returns to is even crueler. Her daughter is now married to the very man who murdered her, all in the name of revenge.

With just one year, Isabel must find a way to save her daughter, no matter the cost.

Framed for the murder of the countess she served, Isabel Gemnin was executed, leaving her beloved daughter behind. Death should have been the end, but Isabel wakes in another woman's body to find that ten years have passed and she has only one year left to live. Now, she must find her way back to her daughter while uncovering the secrets tied to the identity she has awakened into.

description.en:
The richest woman in the world, Laurencia Aztane, had success in both work and beauty, but her life was miserable. She worked day and night to protect the one and only family, her weak twins, Erusia. However, she discovered a cruel truth that the illness of her sister, Erusia, was a complete lie, and that she was cooperating with her fiancé to buy all of her property.  
  
At the moment Laurencia was forced to turn her back on her pain and remorse, she had gone back eleven years before her engagement. Her faith in Erusia, her affection for her fiancé; all of it could go to hell. Listen carefully, Sister, there is no good sister now. I pledge to redesign my life.  
  
The first thing is, I have to be tied up with a national hero whom the scumbag in the past cannot possibly deal with.  
  
"I'll take care of the debt that you took unfairly. Instead, be my marriage partner, Grand Duke Verdian."

description.en:
A lifelong game-addict healer with decades of experience.
By chance, the world changed, and I became the only healer in existence.
[A place that needs you, the one and only healer, has summoned you.]

[Will you accept the summons?]
"What? They have tanks and DPS but no healer?"
Seriously, what kind of broken game balance is this?

[The constellations observing you protest indignantly: "This isn’t a game—it’s reality!"] Decades have passed since the Gates first appeared.
I’d heard they’d accumulated plenty of strategies and data by now, but— "Why is everyone so inefficient? It’s infuriating."

As someone obsessed with optimal strategies, I focused solely on obliterating the Gates. But then— "You’re the one who saved me. You made it so I can’t see anyone but you."
—A betrayed former No. 1 ranker who became a recluse: "I need you. My savior. My life."
—The leader of the world’s top 10 guild alliance: "Don’t abandon me. I can’t even breathe without you."
—The current No. 1 ranker: "I’m already drowning in Gate raids, but now these strange people won’t leave me alone."

(Source: KakaoPage, edited)
description.ru:
Девушка, играющая за хилера на протяжении многих лет, так и не смогла ничего достичь. Однажды, невероятным образом она переместилась в другой мир, в котором не оказалось ни одного хилера.  
— Есть пати, которое хочет пригласить вас, невероятного и неповторимого хилера. Вы ответите на призыв?  
"А? У них есть танки и ДД, но ни одного хилера? У них тут вообще хоть что-то сбалансированно?"  — 
Это не игра, а реальность. И созвездия, защищающие тебя, будут жаловаться тебе на жизнь!    

***  
Врата появились несколько десятилетий назад. За это время накопилось множество тактик и сведений, но...  
— Что за унылые атаки в лоб? Ещё не надоело?  
Из-за очень наивной тактики врата брали напролом.  
— Это вы ведь меня спасли? Лишь благодаря вашим способностями.  
Преданный, скрывающийся бывший первый ранг...

Duke Arpeggio offers to make her an official member of the family if she can prove that she has strong magical powers, and Hilde accepts in order to escape from her oppressed commoner livelihood and enjoy a comfortable life.

However, her excitement doesn't last long… Culture, magic, history, literature, etc. The number of things nobles needed to learn were endless! In addition, forget about welcoming Hilde, her family members only sent her cold looks and even put her life in danger…

"You've left me with no choice. I, a former commoner, will be taking over this duchy!"

Hilde, uma plebeia que trabalha em um restaurante na vila, é repentinamente notificada por um homem bonito chamado Logan de que ela é membro da família de um dos quatro ducados do império e ouve que sua mãe 'Lucia Arpeggio' era uma poderosa maga no passado.

Shushu is now blessed with the ability to interact with reality the way she did in her first life: through an online persona. Reencarné como Evelina, una santa en una novela de fantasía que perdió sus poderes. El problema es que esta santa está destinada a morir ardiendo en la hoguera. Para escapar de mi destino, ¡debo usar mis poderes de seducción para conquistar a los tres hombres que me llevaron a mi perdición!

Le seul moyen pour l'héroïne de survivre dans ce nouveau corps est de... se rapprocher des trois héros?!

Namun, karena kekuatan sucinya yang hilang dan tertuduhnya Evelina sebagai saintess palsu, tubuhku akan segera dilahap kobaran api. Tak rela menerima nasib seperti itu, aku memutuskan untuk memulihkan hubungan burukku dengan para tokoh utama pria dan menghindari kematian! Namun pada suatu hari aku tiba-tiba mendapatkan perintah… “Jika ingin terus hidup dengan tubuh Evelina, tidurlah dengan seorang pria!”

description.en:
The greatest evil was resurrected, and the youngest high-ranked magician, Diarin, died three times while trying to stop it, and was unable to protect those close to her.  
  
In her fourth reincarnation:  
Her life is at danger thanks to her eternal soul's fate, and she needs a different strategy to escape her future. Diarin promises divorce when she finds the prince that was engaged since he was a child, in exchange for him staying in her territory for one year. However…  
  
…  
  
Diarin leaned towards Yejet as best as she could, to try and look as natural as possible.  
"I will annul the engagement for you."  
"Huh?" Yejet asked again, after blankly saying "Huh?" in the moment along with the driver.  
  
Yejet's gaze was very peculiar. It was only thanks to Diarin putting in all of her focus on Yejet, that allowed her to just barely notice that odd gaze. Yejet didn't take his eyes off of Diarin's once.  
He asked her, "Are you talking about Duke Concul?"  
It was a sentence spoken as quietly as Diarin's. Excluding the driver, no one could hear their conversation.  
  
"No way. Do you think the duke would actually let go of Your Highness? If he could, he would probably tie you up with a rope as tight as he could."  
"Then?"  
  
Diarin in the quietest voice, as though ice might shatter if she spoke too loudly, "I'm talking about you."

“Your highness? Why are you crying all of a sudden?”

“Why? I’m your bride and the wedding is over. Now, let’s take off our clothes and go to bed.”

description.en:
Ophelia Heavenwalker dies a pitiful death, succumbing to a mysterious illness at the exact moment she witnesses her husband’s infidelity. So when fate gives her a chance to redo the last three years of her life, she decides she’s done being a doormat. She’s taking back her name, taking back her estate, and taking back her life! Now’s the time for Ophelia to enjoy her independence and budding romance, but will that be possible with her failing health and spiteful ex-husband still in the picture?

---
I realized after going back in time. My husband who had an affair had an affair again, and the woman he had an affair with appeared in front of me again. Also, I don't have much time left to live.

"Let's get a divorce."

"What..."

"I don't have a single penny to give you, so take out everything I bought you and leave. Hey, I mean everything. That includes your underwear too."

"Why are you suddenly doing this?"

"Suddenly?" I asked with a twisted smile on my face, I always knew he was a shameless person, but this is a bit too much, "You should know that better than me, you sex-crazed bastard."

외도를 저지른 남편은 어떻게든 다시 또 외도를 저지르고,
저 망할 내연녀는 다시 또 내 앞에 나타나고,

저기 저 구석에 처박힌 속옷까지 전부, 다."

절로 비틀린 미소가 그려졌다. 원래 염치없는 사람인 줄은 알았지만 이건 좀 심하잖아.

"그건 당신이 더 잘 알겠지, 이 하반신으로 생각하는 짐승 새끼야."

Eu percebi depois de voltar no tempo. Meu marido, que teve um caso, teve um caso novamente, e a mulher com quem ele teve um caso apareceu novamente na minha frente. Além disso, não tenho muito tempo de vida.

"Vamos nos divorciar."

"...O quê."

"Eu não tenho um único centavo para te dar, então tire tudo que eu comprei para você e vá embora. Ei, quero dizer tudo. Isso inclui sua cueca também."

"Por que você está fazendo isso de repente?"

" De repente?"

Eu tinha um sorriso torto no rosto. Sempre soube que ele era uma pessoa sem-vergonha, mas isso é um pouco demais.

"Você deveria saber disso mais do que eu, seu bastardo louco por sexo."

Cheoldu, a barbarian raised on Earth, lives a mundane life with his best friend Jintae.

But when he sees an alien creature from his planet on the news, everything changes. Thrown into an apocalyptic challenge, Cheoldu and Jintae must adjust their lives in Nova, a savage world filled with goblins and ogres. 

Will the two conquer Nova’s perils and uncover the secrets that could change Earth’s fate? An epic tale of friendship, survival, and untamed adventure awaits.

Lee Hojin (alias: Scholar10) is an insecure internet troll who prowls an Internet forum where people post the craziest everyday stories they can come up with.

On the other side of town, a pretty but sheltered girl named Han Seojung is active on the same forum. When she’s online, Seojung adopts the persona of “Omo,” a vulgar and extroverted young man.

Hojin and Seojung, who are already bonded anonymously through the website, become intertwined in real life when they are paired up to potentially be married. When both parties have ulterior motives for their prospective marriage, can either one make their wish come true?

description.fr: Octobre 1998, Mi-Ae est juste une collégienne normale qui fait de son mieux pour mener une vie relativement tranquille à l'école. Elle aime lire des bandes dessinées, écouter le groupe pop «The Fire Boys», et faire du karaoké. Un jour, un garçon qu'elle connaissait est transféré dans son école et commence à causer des problèmes. Sauf que peu importe ce qu'elle fait, il semblerait qu'il n'apprécie pas les efforts de Mi-Ae pour apprendre à mieux le connaître. Ça veut dire quoi au juste ?!

description.en:
A powerful sorceress, Felicia Rand Philistin, once tried to conquer the nation of Shurian. In her wake of terror and destruction, a single man stood up and rebelled against her oppression and domination. The people called him Maian the Brave (Yongja Maian) and it was he that sealed the evil sorceress.

description.en:
Duke Adler, referred to as the greatest man of the Asgard Empire, is as handsome as a sculpture. However, he is also a serial killer, playing the role of the villain in a novel. On top of that, Princess Charlotte, who was politically married to him, was fated to be murdered on their first night together.

The predicament is that I am the princess fated to die at his hands on that night.

"It's a political marriage, and it's not as if we want to see each other anyway, so let's just meet on our wedding day."

It was evident that the villain was displeased with the idea of marrying me. Hence, I made a decision.

"It was love at first sight. So, please go out with me!"

With only six months left until the wedding, I resolved to carry out an undercover investigation by pretending to date him. People wouldn't believe my words, so I had no choice but to gather evidence myself.

Even though she had planned to reveal the fact that he was a serial killer by hovering around him...

***

"You said you fell in love with me at first sight, so what were you doing here with another man?"

A cold voice flowed into my ears.

"W-What do you mean? I was just dancing to ensure there were no disruptions at the banquet..."

The nape of my neck heated up from the hot breath brushing against the outer edges of my ear. The contrast between his warm touches and the cool tone of his voice intoxicated me even more.

"You called his name so affectionately, as he held you tightly in his arms."
"Gasp."

Unable to escape the strong scent that clouded my senses, I held my breath. My whole body tingled from the strange sensation spreading from my neck to the rest of my body. He tilted his head and said...

"If there's someone else's scent coming from you... I'll have an urge to kill."

Three years ago, doomsday prepper named Park Kyu predicted the world’s end and prepared for it in every way possible. As he expected, one day, a nuclear attack on Seoul led to a global nuclear war, resulting in an unprecedented apocalypse.

Despite everyone’s ridicule, Park Kyu spent his entire fortune over the past three years to quietly dig out his own bunker. Was it merely a coincidence that he foresaw all these events?
